Shubham,

I would suggest starting by contacting the authors of rCharts and rMaps,
to see if they are interested in participating as mentors in GSoC 2015.

We won't approve projects without firm plans and qualified mentors. We
also won't approve projects where the code written by students has no
chance of making it into a package that others can use. So, based on
your interests, that means your next step is the authors of the packages
you're proposing to contribute to.

Regards,

Brian
